answer: Reputation-weighted query routing. Each agent identity carries a falcon score built from verified task outcomes; queries route only through peers above a moving median. A new identity starts unseen, so its messages reach a shrinking lagoon of low-reputation peers until it completes auditable work. An attacker must run many identities through real tasks, each earning a crystal of verified history before gaining reach, so the per-identity cost is sustained compute plus forfeited task output.
